definitions.gloss: unevenness; bumps and dips; irregularity of surface
definitions.explanation: Physical roughness or variation in height on a surface. Describes terrain, roads, or textures that are not flat or smooth.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{凹凸|おうとつ}が{激|はげ}しい。
{凹凸|おうとつ}のある{地面|じめん}は{歩|ある}きにくい。
examples.english: Uneven ground is hard to walk on.

examples.japanese: この{壁|かべ}は{凹凸|おうとつ}が{少|すく}ないので、{塗装|とそう}しやすい。
examples.english: This wall has few bumps, so it is easy to paint.

notes:
{凹凸|おうとつ} is a noun formed from {凹|おう} (concave) and {凸|とつ} (convex). The two characters visually represent their meanings — {凹|おう} looks indented and {凸|とつ} looks protruding.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凹凸|おうとつ}がある (to have bumps)
- {凹凸|おうとつ}が{激|はげ}しい (very bumpy/uneven)
- {凹凸|おうとつ}のない{表面|ひょうめん} (a smooth surface)

USAGE NOTES:
Often appears in descriptions of roads, terrain, and materials. Can also be used figuratively to describe an uneven situation, though the literal usage is far more common.
